Thunderstorm Advisory No. 14 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 9:34 AM, 21 September 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Limay and Mariveles), Batangas (Calaca, Tuy, Balayan, Lian, Nasugbu, and Calatagan), Bulacan (Meycauayan, Marilao, and Obando), Cavite (Magallanes, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Alfonso, Amadeo, General Trias, Mendez, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza, Silang, and Indang), Laguna (San Pedro, Binan, and Santa Rosa), Quezon (Jomalig, Patnanungan, Burdeos, and Polillo), and Metro Manila within the next 2 hours.

Keep monitoring for updates.
